[NSTG.4.3] **Hydration writes facts back into the engine.** The handler
selects the matching records and asserts each, in ascending `asserted_at`
order, with the call's correlation as its `corr` and the call's `retain` duration as its TTL ([NCBK.9.2]): a stored
fact by handing its bytes to `ds_engine_assert_external` unchanged
([NCBK.10.4]), a sample as a `HydratedSample` ([LHYD.4.3.1]) via
`ds_engine_assert_with_ttl`. It then asserts the call's `HydrationComplete`
([LHYD.5.1]).
